harness.description: Order service on Node.js, the real Drizzle ORM 0.45.4 and node-postgres 8.23.1: dual write (A), transaction rollback (B), external effect inside a transaction (C), transactional outbox (D).

environment.networkIsolation: bubblewrap: new user, network (loopback only), PID, IPC, UTS and cgroup namespaces; writable: the replay directory only; read-only: /usr, /etc, /sys, /home/tester/work; private /tmp, fresh /proc, minimal /dev
environment.database: ephemeral-postgres: private cluster, Unix socket only (listen_addresses=''), trust authentication for a local test user, fresh database per run, deleted afterwards
